title: Provision and Compass
author: Paloma Okafor
blurb: Isandro Ishikawa, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
